product_overview: BeeGym is a SaaS platform for gyms, studios and personal trainers to manage students, plans, payments (PIX) and workout prescription. It centralizes onboarding, student CRM, invoice lifecycle and workout assignment into a single web app.
core_goals: Allow gym owners and staff to register their organization and complete onboarding so the tenant can be activated.
Register, view and update student profiles and their plan assignments (contacts, address, plan dates, discounts).
Automatically create invoices for paid plans and let staff generate PIX payment payloads/QR codes for collection.
Enable instructors to prescribe, save and assign workouts composed from an exercise library to students.
Provide a central payments view for staff to locate outstanding invoices and generate payment payloads.

features.name: Organization Onboarding & Registration
features.description: Create a new organization account, select a commercial plan and complete onboarding so the tenant becomes active and the dashboard is available.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill name, email, password and confirmPassword according to validation rules -> Submit registration -> Navigate to /app/onboarding -> Select a plan to purchase -> Initiate checkout for selected plan -> Complete payment via PIX -> See dashboard at /app/painel with tenant active

Navigate to /register -> Fill name shorter than 3 characters or invalid email -> Attempt to submit registration -> See field validation errors -> Correct inputs to match validations -> Submit registration

features.name: Student Registration & Management
features.description: Add new students, edit existing student details (name, CPF, phone, full address) and assign them to plans with start and due dates and optional discounts.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/alunos -> Click "Adicionar Aluno" -> Fill name, CPF, phone, street, number, neighborhood, city, state and zip -> Select plan and set startDate and dueDate -> Click "Salvar" to register -> See newly created student in the student list

Navigate to /app/alunos -> Click "Adicionar Aluno" -> Fill CPF with fewer than 14 characters -> Attempt to save -> See CPF validation error requiring 14 characters -> Correct CPF to required format -> Save -> See student in the list

features.name: Automated Invoice Generation
features.description: When a student is enrolled in a paid plan the system generates a pending invoice automatically so staff can collect via PIX or record payments.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/alunos -> Click "Adicionar Aluno" -> Fill student details and select a plan with price greater than 0 -> Click "Salvar" to register student -> Navigate to /app/pagamentos -> See a pending invoice created for the student

Navigate to /app/alunos -> Click "Adicionar Aluno" -> Fill student details and select a plan with price equal to 0 -> Click "Salvar" to register student -> Navigate to /app/pagamentos -> See no pending invoice generated for that student

features.name: PIX Payment (EFI Integration)
features.description: Generate PIX QR codes and copyable 'copia e cola' payloads for outstanding invoices so staff or students can complete payments using their banking apps.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/pagamentos -> Select a pending invoice -> Click "Gerar PIX" -> View generated QR Code and copia e cola payload -> Copy payload to clipboard and paste into a banking app to initiate payment -> After payment completion observe invoice status updated to paid
Navigate to /app/pagamentos -> Select an invoice with value equal to zero -> Attempt to generate PIX -> See validation message disallowing PIX generation for zero-value invoices

features.name: Workout Assignment
features.description: Instructors create new workouts for students by selecting exercises from the library and specifying parameters such as reps, sets and rest; assignments are saved to the student's profile.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/treinos -> Click "Novo Treino" -> Select a student from the list -> Add exercises from the exercise library -> Set reps, sets and rest for each exercise -> Click "Salvar" to assign the workout -> See the workout listed for the selected student

Navigate to /app/treinos -> Click "Novo Treino" -> Select a student -> Attempt to save without adding any exercises -> See validation error requiring at least one exercise -> Add an exercise and complete reps/sets -> Save -> See the workout assigned to the student

known_limitations.issue: Permission system for discounts is currently bypassed if role is not found.
known_limitations.impact: Users might manage discounts without explicit permission until app_roles are fully populated.
